Useful links Recruitment Press Partners Objets perdus Contact us EN EN FR Tickets Stays Tickets Stays Home Discover News Lists 2026 Foundation Day 2026 Foundation Day Share on News from the Le PAL Nature Foundation Tuesday 13 october See the calendar Join us on October 4, 2026, for Foundation Day Save the date of October 4, 2026 to participate to the Foundation Day of the  Le PAL NATURE'S FOUNDATION , a key event dedicated to the protection of flora and fauna. Foundation Day in a Nutshell… Every year during this time, the  Le PAL NATURE'S FOUNDATION   celebrate the world's biodiversity. This event attracts many participants and aims to raise visitors' awareness of the crucial importance of species conservation. Together with  dedicated organizations  and passionate volunteers, we'll be here to answer all your questions. Take this opportunity to discover or rediscover our Sustainable Village ! Coming up... For this 15th edition , visitors will be treated to special activities throughout the wildlife park. Stop by the Foundation’s booth to discover a variety of eco-friendly items. All funds raised during the day will be donated to our partner organizations . Pratical Informations The park will be open from 10:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m . (rides closed). Admission to this event is €12—one price for all (for anyone 1 meter or taller, measured while wearing shoes) . You can purchase tickets online here or at the door on the day of the event.Admission is free for children under one meter tall (measured with shoes on). Vacation checks are accepted. Season Pass and  CSE   tickets will not be accepted on that day.  Dining options will be available on-site at our restaurants (vacation checks accepted) Don't forget to stop by the Comptoir de l'Ours to pick up some memorable souvenirs. For more information, check out our dedicated  Facebook page ! Join us on October 4, 2026, and let’s work together to protect our planet! BOOK NOW Fill up on new things!
